title: Improved user experience
changes: New System Status page - Provides insights into Corporate Identifer usage and sync status.
Reworked Device Search to handle queries with larger numbers of results.
Expanded Device Search to include searching by tag and device state.
Devices in Tags not set to sync to Corporate Identifiers will now move out of Added state after sync processing.  These devices will now show as state Non-Syncing.
Bulk Download now includes a new column with the device state to aid in troubleshooting.
Added device counts to the Tags and Tag Edit pages.
New Help page with recent updates and FAQ content.

title: CorpID Capacity Management Updates
changes: Fixed bug allowing duplicate serial number entries for non-Windows devices.

POSSIBLE USER ACTION NEEDED:  If you have duplicate SNs, remove all entries first and add back the correct entry.  This will ensure the CorpID is resynced promptly, other methods may delay several hours and prevent device enrollment.
Backend updates to prevent exceeding tenant limit on Corporate Identifiers.
Added a Failed status to stop continuous retries on devices that repeatedly fail to sync. If your device is in this state, verify M/M/SN and re-enter.
Fixed a bug where preferred hostname regex validation wasn't executing in all cases.

title: Security Fix
changes: Fixed a security issue on the Devices screen. Should also address issues where tag was not displayed in search results.

title: Duplicate Hostname Prevention
changes: Added logic to prevent users from re-using the same preferred hostname across multiple devices. Past duplicates may still exist.

title: Logging & Telemetry Improvements
changes: Improved logging and telemetry to capture more detailed information for troubleshooting and performance monitoring.

title: Implemented Preferred Hostname format validation by tag
changes: Enhancing the system-wide Preferred Hostname validation requirement with tag-specific requirements.
Added Tag Search.

title: Intune Autopilot 2.0 Support
changes: Added ability to enable syncing of devices to the Intune Corporate Identifiers list at tag level.
New state field related to CorpID sync status.

Added a new OS field to support future use of MacOS, iOS, and Android devices. (Currently experimental.)  All devices previously entered are processed will show an OS of Unknown, but will be treated as Windows devices.
Added new Preferred Hostname field to support device naming on enrollment in support of Intune Autopilot 2.0.
Improved the devices screen and search capabilities.
